remediationControls.name: GRAPH-DERIVATION
remediationControls.remediationStatement: Derive every node, edge and denominator from one canonical set and reject declared/physical disagreement.

remediationControls.name: READER-INDEPENDENCE
remediationControls.remediationStatement: Bind independently specified Readers to distinct implementations, dependencies, runtimes, controllers and input cuts; disagreement blocks.

remediationControls.name: CLOSED-SCHEMAS
remediationControls.remediationStatement: Materialize all 42 output schemas and every referenced nested type with executable closed validation.

remediationControls.name: DIGEST-TYPE-SEPARATION
remediationControls.remediationStatement: Separate raw byte checksums from domain-separated typed identities and reject cross-class substitution.

remediationControls.name: GENESIS-APPOINTMENT-RECOVERY
remediationControls.remediationStatement: Define external Genesis, sole-producer appointments, expected-empty/current heads and independent recovery ownership.

remediationControls.name: LIFECYCLE-CAS
remediationControls.remediationStatement: Execute issue, consume, revoke, expire, crash and response-loss transitions through one atomic CAS reducer.

remediationControls.name: FINDING-EXTRACTION
remediationControls.remediationStatement: Root canonical Finding fields with byte-span provenance and one-to-one identity-only Alias projections.

remediationControls.name: CAUSAL-VECTORS
remediationControls.remediationStatement: Materialize pre-state, mutation, evaluator, actual terminal and effect set for every vector.

remediationControls.name: CLOSURE-COVERAGE
remediationControls.remediationStatement: Provide forward and inverse coverage for every Finding, mapped Requirement and atomic predicate without shared credit.

remediationControls.name: DUAL-ALLOWLIST
remediationControls.remediationStatement: Appoint two allowlist builders and a separate adjudicator with disjoint work, ledger, implementation and owners.

remediationControls.name: SCANNER-INDEPENDENCE
remediationControls.remediationStatement: Appoint two scanners and an adjudicator with distinct engines, rulesets, work, ledgers and owners on one byte cut.

remediationControls.name: CONTROL-PERMIT
remediationControls.remediationStatement: Define a typed one-use GitHub control-plane Permit transaction with ordered steps, security floor and recovery.

remediationControls.name: PUBLIC-PUSH-PERMIT
remediationControls.remediationStatement: Bind Push Permit CAS to exact repository/ref/OID and sent, accepted and quarantined object sets plus PUBLIC readback.

remediationControls.name: DEPLOYMENT-PERMIT
remediationControls.remediationStatement: Separate deployment issuer, consumer and reader and bind target digests, heads, TTL, failure and recovery.

remediationControls.name: RELEASE-PERMIT
remediationControls.remediationStatement: Separate release issuer, publisher and reader and bind immutable public identities with successor-only recovery.

remediationControls.name: FOUR-PERMIT-SEPARATION
remediationControls.remediationStatement: Define four disjoint schemas, domains and NamedUses and execute the complete 4x4 presentation matrix.

remediationControls.name: DETACHED-ACCEPTANCE-CUT
remediationControls.remediationStatement: Keep the package root cycle-free and bind manifest and detached Reader receipts only in a higher envelope.

remediationControls.name: NO-SELF-ACCEPTANCE
remediationControls.remediationStatement: Separate implementation, evidence, reviewers, veto, reconciliation and acceptance across every independence dimension.

remediationControls.name: SECRET-COORDINATE-PRIVACY
remediationControls.remediationStatement: Prohibit public low-entropy equality commitments and require an approved private mechanism before validation.

remediationControls.name: LATE-DECISION-ADMISSION
remediationControls.remediationStatement: Admit the exact late storage decision and reconcile every numbered clause forward and inverse.

remediationControls.name: SIZE-GROWTH-CLONE-GATES
remediationControls.remediationStatement: Enforce strict member size and block unknown or exceeded repository total, growth and clone budgets.

remediationControls.name: GENERATOR-FIRST-SHARDS
remediationControls.remediationStatement: Generate ordered deterministic shards from frozen roots and reject every range, root, count or generator drift.

remediationControls.name: EXTERNAL-ARTIFACT-LIFECYCLE
remediationControls.remediationStatement: Define a provider-neutral immutable external-artifact lifecycle and keep selection missing and blocking.
